verdict.rationale: Zero doesn't offer an explicit region/residency selection feature, but its self-hosting capability (zero-gh-2, zero-gh-6, zero-gh-8, zero-gh-13, zero-gh-16) lets users deploy the app on infrastructure of their choosing, which indirectly gives control over data location, and it claims not to track/sell user data (zero-gh-15). missing for 10: explicit data-residency/region selection controls, documented data storage locations for hosted/cloud version, and independent confirmation of self-hosted deployments achieving residency compliance.
